verdict.rationale: Evidence shows several capabilities are explicitly UI/Dashboard-only — e.g., the no-code Workflow Management editor for creating flows (plaid-idv-docs-8) and overriding failed verifications 'via the Dashboard by clicking the Override Result button' (plaid-idv-docs-7) — with no documented API equivalent for either. There is no evidence of a full API surface mirroring these UI actions, so the story is not shown to be delivered.
